@Kim2001-vv proposed the fully sequential, indifference-zone selection procedure.

```pseudocode
#| label: algo-indifference-zone-selection

\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Fully Sequential, Indifference-Zone Selection Procedure}
\begin{algorithmic}
\Require indifference zone $\delta$, first-stage  sample  size $n_0$, confidence level $1-\alpha$
\State $\eta = \frac{1}{2} \left[ \left( \frac{2\alpha}{k-1} \right)^{-2/(n_0-1)} - 1 \right]$
\State $t^2 = 2 \eta (n_0 - 1)$
\State Obtain $n_0$ observations $Y_j (\mathbf{x}_i)$

\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
```
